title: The silver birch room
alt: A sleeping striped cat rests beside a sketchbook and blue jugs of birch branches in a sunlit room.
description: A richly textured painted interior with natural animal anatomy, layered foliage and coherent perspective.
prompt: A meticulously painted interior in the style of an original contemporary oil painting. A sunlit room contains a pale wooden table, a blue ceramic jug of birch branches, an open sketchbook and one striped cat asleep in a wicker chair. A tall window frames a cool green garden. The cat has one continuous relaxed body, one head and one tail; delicate paws are naturally tucked beneath. Rich brushwork, balanced warm and cool colour, accurate interior perspective, no legible writing.
